items.rationale: The fixed unit suffered covered lightning overvoltage under §2.3.3 and was nine metres from the hob, outside the §2.3.10(c) exclusion. Under §§7.1.9–7.1.10, one replacement is valued at €1,411 gross for the pre-loss 3.5 kW specification, not the upgraded 7.1 kW model.

Sections 7.1.9(c) and 7.1.11 cover removal, fitting, connection and commissioning to the extent needed for an equivalent replacement. One installation is estimated at €482 gross, excluding any upgrade-specific labour.

Sections 3.5(d) and 7.1.10 exclude the entire console because it was chosen for appearance and was not needed to install the replacement. The conditional estimate uses €60 gross for one comparable console.
Sections 7.1.9(e), 7.1.11 and 7.1.12 allow ordinary carriage for the equivalent replacement. One shipment is estimated at €42 gross, separate from the express surcharge.

Section 7.1.12 excludes express and timed delivery surcharges unless agreed in advance or needed to prevent further loss; neither exception is shown. The conditional estimate is €50 gross for one flat-rate surcharge.
Section 7.1.8(b) excludes separately billed contractor administration as a business expense rather than a reinstatement cost. The conditional estimate is €35 gross for one flat-rate fee.
